newsitem.title: UKRAINE: TABLE - Ukraine 6-,9-,12-,18-mo T-bill yields down.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - Ukraine 6-,9-,12-,18-mo T-bill yields down.

text.p: Average yields at auctions of six-month, nine-month, 12-month and 18-month treasury bills edged down from the last sales, a central bank said on Wednesday.

Six-month bills eased to 20.13 percent from 20.15 percent, nine-month bills slipped to 27.70 percent from 27.71 percent, 12-month bills fell to 29.65 percent from 29.99 percent, and 18-month bills dropped to 32.45 from 32.53 percent.
The results of the six-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 18.50 million UAH 18.50 million UAH
Amount sold 17.27 million UAH 17.23 million UAH
Actual amount raised 15.69 million UAH 15.66 million UAH
The central bank sold 172,677 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for July 24.
The results of the nine-month discount T-bill auction,
compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 16.00 million UAH 16.00 million UAH
Amount sold 16.00 million UAH 12.67 million UAH
Actual amount raised 13.25 million UAH 10.49 million UAH
The central bank sold 160,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for July 24.
The results of the 12-month discount T-bill auction,
compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 47.50 million UAH 47.50 million UAH
Amount sold 47.50 million UAH 47.50 million UAH
Actual amount raised 36.66 million UAH 36.57 million UAH
The central bank sold 475,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for July 24.
The results of the 18-month discount T-bill auction,
compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated no limit stated
Amount sold 5.96 million UAH 6.46 million UAH
Actual amount raised 4.01 million UAH 4.34 million UAH
The central bank sold 59,619 T-bills, the bank's statement
The date of the next auction of 18-month discount T-bills is scheduled for July 24.
